protocol.cohort: All 120 frozen Imazen development source families, no replacements or exclusions after encoding
protocol.preprocessing: Sharp/libvips dev oracle converts embedded-profile source samples to sRGB RGB8, retaining the stored raster dimensions without resize or auto-orientation. All source alpha is independently audited fully opaque; RGB comparison omits that constant channel. Metadata is stripped identically for every compressor. Original display orientation remains recorded, not applied. This normalized 8-bit SDR subset does not qualify native high-depth or transparent-source gates.
protocol.performance: Concurrent size and exactness evaluation; elapsed times and process memory are observational, not isolated performance evidence.

summary.qualification: Development only. Median passes; p90 and worst fail. Native-depth, transparency, holdout and isolated performance gates remain open.
